systems.name: Arizona State Retirement System

statute.quote: "ASRS" means the Arizona state retirement system established by this article.

source.quote: The board is responsible for supervising the administration of this article by the director of ASRS.

website_source.quote: For more than 70 years, the Arizona State Retirement System has provided retirement security to Arizona’s public servants, including teachers, municipal workers, and other government employees.

covers_local_source.quote: means: (a) This state. (b) Participating political subdivisions. (c) Participating political subdivision entities.

systems.notes: The current article names the system by definition (38-711) and gives it corporate powers under the name "Arizona state retirement system" (38-714); the ASRS board is established by 38-713. Covers school district and university employees through participating employers.

systems.name: Public Safety Personnel Retirement System

statute.quote: In order to provide a uniform, consistent and equitable statewide program for public safety personnel who are regularly assigned hazardous duty in the employ of the state of Arizona or a political subdivision thereof, this retirement system was created

body.name: Board of trustees of the Public Safety Personnel Retirement System

source.quote: "Board" means the board of trustees of the system, who are the persons appointed to invest and operate the fund.

website_source.quote: Welcome to the Public Safety Personnel Retirement System (PSPRS), where we are committed to honoring the service of Arizona’s first responders, corrections officers, elected officials and judges.

covers_local_source.quote: In order to provide a uniform, consistent and equitable statewide program for public safety personnel who are regularly assigned hazardous duty in the employ of the state of Arizona or a political subdivision thereof, this retirement system was created

systems.notes: Municipal police and fire, county sheriffs' deputies and state public safety employees; employer-level local boards handle membership determinations.

systems.name: Corrections Officer Retirement Plan

statute.quote: The corrections officer retirement plan and the corrections officer retirement plan fund are established.

body.name: Board of trustees of the Public Safety Personnel Retirement System

source.quote: The board is entitled to administer, manage and operate the plan and fund.

website_source.quote: Over the years, our mission expanded to encompass the Corrections Officer Retirement Plan (CORP) and the Elected Officials’ Retirement Plan (EORP).

covers_local_source.quote: means an agency or department of this state or a political subdivision of this state that has one or more employees in a designated position.

systems.notes: Census reports the judiciary group (CORP-AOC: probation, surveillance and juvenile detention officers) as a separate unit; it is part of CORP. Covers state corrections staff and county and city detention officers.

systems.name: Elected Officials' Retirement Plan

statute.quote: The elected officials' retirement plan is established. B. The elected officials' retirement plan fund is established.

body.name: Board of trustees of the Public Safety Personnel Retirement System

source.quote: The board shall administer, manage and operate the plan and fund.

website_source.quote: Over the years, our mission expanded to encompass the Corrections Officer Retirement Plan (CORP) and the Elected Officials’ Retirement Plan (EORP).

covers_local_source.quote: Every elected official of each county of this state who was a member of the plan on December 31, 2013.

systems.notes: Closed to elected officials taking office after December 31, 2013; covers state and county elected officials and justices and judges.
